description: Capability for the main window. App commands (open_link, install_update, ...) need no grant; the frontend additionally only listens to Rust events, reads the app version, drags the frameless window by its handle (data-tauri-drag-region), and reads back the dragged position to persist it. No core:default — it would expose core:image allow-from-path (arbitrary PNG read + pixel exfiltration) plus unused tray/menu/path/window grants.
